synthesis.content:
Central thread
Explain how the ocean channel lets a hydrophone pick up distant whale calls. Keep the account to the mechanism and listening example.

Evidence
SOFAR stands for Sound Fixing and Ranging. This naturally occurring ocean channel allows low-frequency sound to travel long distances as sound waves bend up and down. Hydrophones at the channel's axis can detect faraway sounds, including whale calls. In some instances low-frequency sounds carry across entire ocean basins.
